description: §5 / §22 (S459 round 6, F2) — the clean twin of emit-single-quoted-attr-reject: a single quote INSIDE a double-quoted attribute value in emitted meta markup (`onclick="go('a')"`) is ordinary value content, not a delimiter, and compiles.
rationale: SPEC §5: the attribute quoted-string form is `"`-only; a `'` inside a `"…"` value is part of the value.
